phonepe.label: PhonePe
phonepe.description: PhonePe PG for Indian merchants (UPI, cards, wallets). V2 (OAuth) Standard Checkout. Settles in INR only.

setupSteps.step1: Sign in to the PhonePe Business dashboard (business.phonepe.com) with your PhonePe for Business merchant login.
setupSteps.step2: Go to Developer Settings → API Keys. New (V2) merchants see a Client ID, Client Secret and Client Version — copy all three into the fields below.
setupSteps.step3: Legacy merchants only: if you were instead given a Salt Key + Salt Index, put your Merchant ID in “Client ID”, your Salt Key (as KEY###INDEX) in “Client Secret”, and LEAVE “Client Version” blank.
setupSteps.step4: Set “API Base URL”: V2 LIVE = https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg, V2 UAT/Sandbox = https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox (legacy V1 = https://api.phonepe.com/apis/hermes).
setupSteps.step5: Under Developer Settings → Webhooks, add the Webhook URL shown below and set a username + password. Enter the same username/password below to secure incoming callbacks.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.placeholder: V2 Client ID (or legacy Merchant ID)
clientId.helper: V2: Client ID from Developer Settings → API Keys. Legacy V1 merchants: your Merchant ID (MID).

clientSecret.label: Client Secret
clientSecret.placeholder: V2 Client Secret (or legacy Salt Key###index)
clientSecret.helper: V2: your Client Secret. Legacy V1 merchants: your Salt Key, pasted as KEY###INDEX (index usually 1). Kept secret.

clientVersion.label: Client Version
clientVersion.helper: V2 only — the Client Version from the dashboard (usually 1). LEAVE BLANK if you are a legacy merchant using a Salt Key.

baseUrl.label: API Base URL
baseUrl.helper: V2 LIVE: https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg • V2 UAT: https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox • Legacy V1: https://api.phonepe.com/apis/hermes

webhookUsername.label: Webhook Username (optional)
webhookUsername.placeholder: Same username you set on PhonePe → Webhooks
webhookUsername.helper: Enables signature verification of incoming callbacks. Must match the username configured on the PhonePe dashboard.

webhookPassword.label: Webhook Password (optional)
webhookPassword.placeholder: Same password you set on PhonePe → Webhooks
webhookPassword.helper: Must match the password configured on the PhonePe dashboard. Leave both webhook fields blank to skip verification.

publicKey.label: Public API Key
publicKey.helper: Used by the learner checkout in the browser.
